classification: Current-research historical context; latest-reported evidence, not an as-released backtest or forecasts.

methodology.selection: Last five complete fiscal years; a sixth preceding annual observation supports growth and beginning-capital denominators. Latest eligible annual filing per period/concept, through cutoff; can include recasts. Quarter and YTD facts excluded.
methodology.capitalProxy: Book equity + explicitly mapped debt − cash and cash equivalents. Not adjusted invested capital: does not deduct marketable securities or capitalize R&D, normalize leases, remove goodwill, or validate all debt/claims.
methodology.reinvestmentWarning: Historical total sales/book-capital is a stock ratio. The model uses incremental revenue/reinvestment. Neither that stock ratio nor changes in book capital are a direct measurement of economic marginal reinvestment.
methodology.taxWarning: Tax/pretax income only when pretax income > 0. Tax benefits or >100% rates shown but excluded from normal ranges/ROIC. Effective accounting tax is not a forecast marginal cash-tax rate; no NOL schedule.
methodology.rangeWarning: Observed min/median/max of available observations are descriptive, not recommended ranges or prediction intervals.
methodology.temporalWarning: History uses latest-reported data and must not be used to assert what was known at an earlier date.
